summary: Six bounded repair tools and their diagnostic connections are implemented. 6 of six cases in this expansion passed hosted Sonnet traffic qualification. Requested fresh evidence also passed a separate hosted check. Green means only the stated verified scope, amber is partial, gray is remaining. Offline snapshot; customer rollout is unfinished.

owner.scope: Owns the project and decides what Pooltune may inspect or change.
owner.remaining: Customer permissions must be explicit before automatic work.

customer-db.scope: Rookery on Supabase supplies the measured staging workload.
customer-db.remaining: General project connections and additional providers are not implemented.

model.scope: Claude interprets evidence and returns a typed proposal or no change.
model.remaining: Provider failures and incorrect decisions remain possible; Go must independently check every action.

collector.scope: Built in staging: collect enrolled query counters and detect repeated slowdowns.
collector.remaining: Broader signals, workload calibration and automatic query enrollment remain.

scheduler.scope: Built in staging: saved jobs, an always-on consumer, retries and delayed follow-ups survive restarts.
scheduler.remaining: Customer scheduling limits and abandoned-investigation lifecycle still need work.

state.scope: Built in staging: PostgreSQL saves measurements, jobs, action intent and graph checkpoints.
state.remaining: Account isolation, retention, backup/restore qualification and production secret handling remain.

investigator.scope: One diagnostic graph compares causes, requests named Go evidence and routes permitted proposals to all six guarded executors. Current hosted results are linked in the repair-connection children.
investigator.remaining: General customer collectors, broader workloads, remaining requested-reader coverage and hosted mid-model recovery remain.

tools.scope: Six bounded repair cases are verified; broader evidence collection and customer repair coverage remain.
tools.remaining: Expand the amber repair families and gray connections. Green child cards describe bounded tested cases, not full production capabilities.

inspection.scope: Named bounded readers now cover the six owned repair fixture types. Local PostgreSQL evidence/refusal checks passed.
inspection.remaining: Qualify requested live Rookery reads and hosted outcomes; general enrolled customer readers remain.

experiments.scope: Controlled before/after trials test whether a permitted change helps and harms other traffic.
experiments.remaining: General experiment selection, customer resource headroom and representative workloads remain.

index.scope: Single-column and one ordered two-column staging case verified with real Claude and traffic.
index.remaining: Broaden query shapes, customer enrollment and committed writes to the repaired table.

refresh.scope: Targeted ANALYZE case verified: refresh stale statistics and measure the result.
refresh.remaining: Broader stale-statistics signals and representative customer traffic remain.

richer.scope: Joint-statistics case verified for related predicate columns.
richer.remaining: Column statistics targets and broader data distributions remain.

cleanup.scope: Plain VACUUM case verified: reduce visibility work without replacing the index.
cleanup.remaining: Recurring cleanup settings and broader maintenance workloads remain.

memory.scope: Function-memory case verified with attributed disk spill and a fixed test memory budget.
memory.remaining: Customer memory headroom, representative functions and wider concurrency remain.

cron.scope: Scheduling case verified: move one job to an allowed quiet minute and preserve deadlines after restart.
cron.remaining: Real customer schedules, broader interference and safe recovery windows remain.

recovery.scope: Staging verification measures benefit and protected traffic; saved intent supports repair-specific recovery.
recovery.remaining: Customer lifecycle, uncertain external changes and broader failure coverage remain.

backend.scope: Hosted project API remains to be built for configuration, permissions and result access.
backend.remaining: Wire account ownership, credentials, enrollment, pause/disconnect and authorized history.

dashboard.scope: Customer application remains to be built: sign-in, projects and visible repair activity.
dashboard.remaining: The legacy dashboard is not the hosted product. No final frontend or auth provider is selected.

studio.scope: Developer graph registration and scripted replay were verified; Studio shows the investigator graph.
studio.remaining: A live view covering detector, queue, Go actions and outcomes still needs integration. Studio is not the customer dashboard.

screen-evidence.scope: Built: check supplied measurements and skip unsupported or healthy cases.
screen-evidence.remaining: Broader diagnosis must still use fresh evidence and retain no-change outcomes.

model-recommendation.scope: Built: send plan, index checks and the supplied cause evidence together; validate the response.
model-recommendation.remaining: These are one-cause cases, not a completed open-ended diagnostic loop.

diagnose-causes.scope: Sonnet passed 15/15 bounded local/replay cases. In Railway it selected an index and rejected statistics/cleanup explanations before a verified repair.
diagnose-causes.remaining: Replay covers 18 bounded cases. Current hosted repair connections are listed separately; broader customer diagnosis and representative mixed causes remain unqualified.

request-evidence.scope: Named Go readers and local durable evidence recovery are built. A separate Railway/Rookery test had real Sonnet request fresh ANALYZE evidence before choosing a repair; no repair executed in that probe.
request-evidence.remaining: Requested hosted evidence for the remaining families and hosted mid-model checkpoint recovery remain unqualified.

repair-coverage.scope: Remaining: test richer repair variants and ordinary application workloads.
repair-coverage.remaining: Compound indexes, statistics targets, cleanup settings, candidate-table writes, realistic memory budgets and schedules.

connect-project.scope: Next: accept an authorized project connection and select the queries and objects Pooltune may manage.
connect-project.remaining: Dedicated Rookery evidence/revocation passed; general onboarding and repair grants are unfinished.

credential-lifecycle.scope: Remaining: store credentials securely, rotate them and stop access/work when disconnected.
credential-lifecycle.remaining: Customer credential lifecycle and shutdown of in-flight sessions/jobs need implementation.

auth.scope: Remaining: create accounts and restrict every project and action to its owner.
auth.remaining: Google/GitHub sign-in choices and auth provider remain open; account sign-in is separate from database access.

activity.scope: Next: show detection, investigation, applied changes, verification and pause controls.
activity.remaining: Join Go worker and LangGraph events into one understandable timeline.

landing.scope: Remaining: explain Pooltune and guide a new user into their first project.
landing.remaining: Implement the hosted web experience; keep product details understandable.

operations.scope: Remaining: qualify account separation, operating limits, monitoring and recovery for customer use.
operations.remaining: Backups/restore, retention, cost limits, deployment/outage behavior and abandoned jobs remain.

hosted-diagnostic-integration.scope: Connected and verified for the owned index fixture: Railway queue → diagnostic Sonnet graph → Go index repair → measured improvement. Queued job survived an actual service restart.
hosted-diagnostic-integration.remaining: The bounded single-column service-restart proof remains distinct from the newer per-repair runs. All six routes are implemented; see each connection for its verified scope. Hosted mid-model recovery remains.

diagnostic-adapter-coverage.scope: All five existing repair tools now run through the shared diagnostic investigator and guarded Go executor, with real Sonnet and owned Rookery traffic.
diagnostic-adapter-coverage.remaining: General customer collectors, requested-reader coverage across every family and broader workload qualification remain.

index-single.scope: Single-column index case verified with real Claude and ongoing traffic.
index-single.remaining: Broader query shapes and committed writes to the repaired table remain; the bounded two-column case has its own verified node.

index-compound.scope: One ordered two-column nonunique B-tree case passed real Sonnet, guarded build, before/after traffic and cleanup in Railway/Rookery. Local tests cover identity and interrupted recovery.
index-compound.remaining: Broader compound query shapes, customer grants and concurrent committed writes to the repaired table remain unqualified.

statistics-joint.scope: Joint-statistics case verified for related predicate columns.
statistics-joint.remaining: Column statistics targets and broader data distributions remain.

statistics-target.scope: Remaining V1 work: increase detail collected for an individual column when the measured evidence warrants it.
statistics-target.remaining: Implement bounded column targets, preserve prior settings and verify benefit, resource cost and recovery with real Claude.

cleanup-vacuum.scope: Plain VACUUM case verified: reduce visibility work without replacing the index.
cleanup-vacuum.remaining: Recurring cleanup settings and broader maintenance workloads remain.

cleanup-settings.scope: Remaining V1 work: qualify permitted cleanup threshold adjustments beyond the tested plain VACUUM operation.
cleanup-settings.remaining: Define allowed settings, admission, benefit verification and restoration before automatic changes.

diagnostic-analyze.scope: Statistics refresh: diagnostic Sonnet chose the repair through the Railway consumer; Go applied it and verified benefit under owned Rookery traffic. Healthy and brief-spike controls passed.
diagnostic-analyze.remaining: General customer enrollment and representative workloads remain. This successful action run reused initial evidence; it does not prove every named reader was requested live.

diagnostic-statistics.scope: Joint statistics: diagnostic Sonnet chose the repair through the Railway consumer; Go applied it and verified benefit under owned Rookery traffic. Healthy and brief-spike controls passed.
diagnostic-statistics.remaining: General customer enrollment and representative workloads remain. This successful action run reused initial evidence; it does not prove every named reader was requested live.

diagnostic-vacuum.scope: Targeted cleanup: diagnostic Sonnet chose the repair through the Railway consumer; Go applied it and verified benefit under owned Rookery traffic. Healthy and brief-spike controls passed.
diagnostic-vacuum.remaining: General customer enrollment and representative workloads remain. This successful action run reused initial evidence; it does not prove every named reader was requested live.

diagnostic-memory.scope: Function memory: diagnostic Sonnet chose the repair through the Railway consumer; Go applied it and verified benefit under owned Rookery traffic. Healthy and brief-spike controls passed.
diagnostic-memory.remaining: General customer enrollment and representative workloads remain. This successful action run reused initial evidence; it does not prove every named reader was requested live.

diagnostic-cron.scope: Job scheduling: diagnostic Sonnet chose the repair through the Railway consumer; Go applied it and verified benefit under owned Rookery traffic. Healthy and brief-spike controls passed.
diagnostic-cron.remaining: General customer enrollment and representative workloads remain. This successful action run reused initial evidence; it does not prove every named reader was requested live.

index-compound-general.scope: Qualify compound indexes on representative enrolled customer query shapes beyond the fixed two-equality fixture, including write/storage cost and safe recovery.
index-compound-general.remaining: Design candidate selection and validate representative inputs, roles, workload interference and current owner grants.
